verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents Incident Workflows as a first-party engine with configurable triggers and actions. It applies "if-this-then-that" logic, for example auto-triggering for all P1 and P2 incidents, which covers condition-based automation driven by incident events. The specific toil actions named in the story (status updates, reminders, field changes) are not documented in the evidence, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented action types for stakeholder updates, reminders and incident field changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine.

support.subject: As an SRE, a condition-based workflow engine automates the toil — updates, reminders, field changes — triggered by incident events

citations.quote: Incident Workflows allow you to build an automated response for every incident.
Through highly-configurable triggers and actions, you can apply "if-this-then-that" logic to orchestrate the right response for your teams
you can configure one workflow that automatically triggers for all P1 and P2 incidents
